new_derivations.title: ε0[2] collapses to ω+2
new_derivations.method: Under ε0[2]=ω^ω, (ω^ω)[2]=ω², (ω²)[2]=ω·2, (ω·2)[2]=ω+2, successively apply limit rule.

new_derivations.title: Knuth arrow right operand two
new_derivations.method: The defining recurrence gives a↑^k2=a↑^(k−1)(a↑^k1) and a↑^k1=a.

new_derivations.title: F3 large-n asymptotic compression
new_derivations.statement: L_n(F3(n)) ≈ n log10 2 + log10 n + log10(log10 2)
new_derivations.method: Using log10(x2)=log10(x1)+x1 log10 2, x1=n2^n; repeated logs cancel dominant exponentiation layers. Lower-n corrections matter.
new_derivations.verification: heuristic; error bound not yet certified

new_derivations.title: DAG not tree for g iteration
new_derivations.statement: n g-applications can use O(n) shared nodes
new_derivations.method: Every g(x)=x·2^x refers twice to prior x; naive substitution duplicates references; hash-consed DAG shares once per step.

new_derivations.title: Tower peeling by base-10 logs
new_derivations.method: Define T0=1, T_(h+1)=10^T_h. Log10(T_h)=T_(h−1); induction for k≤h.
